entities.name: Oko
entities.description: A faerie planeswalker from Lorwyn-Shadowmoor, the first creation of Oona, a charismatic shapeshifting trickster and father of Kellan.

entities.name: Oona
entities.description: The faerie queen from whom all the plane's faeries originated, who created Oko and Maralen as avatars.

entities.name: Maralen
entities.description: Oko's sister, another avatar of Oona who rebelled and destroyed her, and fae queen of Glen Elendra.

entities.name: Kellan
entities.description: Oko's half-fae son by Alyse, who traveled across planes to find him.

entities.name: Alyse
entities.description: A human hedgewitch on Eldraine who bore Oko's son Kellan.

entities.name: Garruk Wildspeaker
entities.description: A planeswalker hunter whom Oko trapped and enthralled as a slave bodyguard called Dog.

entities.name: Will Kenrith
entities.description: One of the Kenrith twins, suspicious of Oko.

entities.name: Rowan Kenrith
entities.description: One of the Kenrith twins, who forbade Garruk from killing Oko.

entities.name: Queen Ayara
entities.description: An elven queen who suspected Oko and whose form he took to shoot the stag.

entities.name: Cado
entities.description: A knight whose form Oko took to enter the Grand Procession.

entities.name: Elowen
entities.description: A loremage who deduced Oko was not of Locthwain.

entities.name: Cerise
entities.description: A healer who arrived with Garruk, her unicorn and the stag.

entities.name: High King
entities.description: The ruler of the Realm of Eldraine whom Oko kidnapped and turned into a stag.

entities.name: Ashiok
entities.description: A planeswalker who hired Oko for a heist at Maag Taranau, revealed to be Jace in disguise.

entities.name: Jace Beleren
entities.description: A planeswalker who disguised himself as Ashiok and, with Vraska, set Oko up.

entities.name: Vraska
entities.description: A planeswalker gorgon in Oko's heist crew whose gaze nearly petrified him.

entities.name: Annie Flash
entities.description: A gunslinger recruited for her ability to see through illusions.

entities.name: Akul
entities.description: A dragon, leader of the Hellspurs gang, who held five keys to Maag Taranau.

entities.name: Bertram Graywater
entities.description: The head of the Sterling Company who held one of the vault keys.

entities.name: Ral Zarek
entities.description: A planeswalker who worked with the Sterling Company and accompanied a fae magic user.

entities.name: Rakdos
entities.description: A demon in Oko's crew who sent Ral flying.

entities.name: Tinybones
entities.description: A skeletal member of Oko's crew, smuggled in a box and used to steal the key.

entities.name: Gisa
entities.description: A necromancer in the crew whose zombies overran the train.

entities.name: Geralf Cecani
entities.description: Gisa's brother, in the heist crew.

entities.name: Eriette
entities.description: A crew member who told Oko that Kellan had escaped the vault.

entities.name: Kaervek
entities.description: A gang member broken out of Sterling Company cells.

entities.name: Satoru Umezawa
entities.description: A gang member freed from prison who helped secure the key.

entities.name: Breeches
entities.description: A crew member who exploded a bridge to stop the train and later abandoned the team.

entities.name: Malcolm
entities.description: A crew member who abandoned the team after the heist.

entities.name: Nolan
entities.description: A scholar of magical artifacts hired by the Sterling Company to analyze the key.

entities.name: Sterling Company
entities.description: The Thunder Junction organization headed by Bertram Graywater.

entities.name: Hellspurs
entities.description: A gang led by the dragon Akul based in Tarnation.

entities.name: Maag Taranau
entities.description: The vault on Thunder Junction that Oko's crew sought to rob.

entities.name: Tarnation
entities.description: Akul's base of operations.

entities.name: Thunder Junction
entities.description: A Western-style plane where Oko's heist took place.

entities.name: Eldraine
entities.description: The plane where Oko fathered Kellan and tried to disrupt the Realm.

entities.name: Lorwyn-Shadowmoor
entities.description: Oko's home plane with two aspects.

entities.name: Glen Elendra
entities.description: The faerie domain ruled by Maralen.

entities.name: Isilu
entities.description: The incarnation of night, prematurely awakened by Strixhaven students.

entities.name: Morcant
entities.description: The elven army leader who had the medicine dawnglow.

entities.name: Rhys
entities.description: Maralen's retainer who wounded her with a moonglow dagger.

entities.name: Wild Hunt
entities.description: The hunting elves that Oko guided to the stag.

events.summary: Oona captures the giant Oko called father and has him publicly executed.
events.quote: Oona captured the giant Oko called "father" and had him publicly executed.

events.summary: Oko leaves his home plane, intending never to return.
events.quote: he seized the opportunity to leave the plane, intending never to return

events.summary: Oko meets the hedgewitch Alyse on Eldraine and later fathers Kellan, but leaves her after lashing out at the villagers.
events.quote: Oko met the human hedgewitch Alyse in a field of nightshade

events.summary: Oko traps Garruk in thorn vines and mesmerizes him into a slave bodyguard called Dog.
events.quote: Oko mesmerized Garruk, turning him into a slave bodyguard called Dog .

events.summary: Oko plots to eliminate the High King during the Grand Procession to destroy the peace between the elves and the Realm.
events.quote: he plotted to eliminate the High King himself

events.summary: Oko has Garruk save Will and Rowan from redcaps and charms Rowan.
events.quote: had Garruk save the duo from a horde of redcaps

events.summary: Oko, in the form of Cado, joins the Grand Procession, bewitches the twins, has Garruk kill the guards and kidnaps the king.
events.quote: he kidnaps the man and flees into the wilds

events.summary: Oko tries to turn Queen Ayara against humans but she finds him suspect.
events.quote: the woman thought him suspect

events.summary: Oko turns the High King into a stag and puts it to sleep, planning to have the Wild Hunt find it.
events.quote: he had transformed the High King into a stag and had magically put it to sleep

events.summary: The Kenrith twins enter Oko's circle and their memories return; Elowen sees through him and he escapes as an eagle.
events.quote: Elowen quickly deduced he was not of Locthwain as he claimed

events.summary: Oko reveals his plans and binds the adventurers in a dome of thorns, then walks off with the stag.
events.quote: Oko revealed his plans and created a dome of thorns to bind the adventurers

events.summary: Oko, as Queen Ayara, shoots the stag; he evades Garruk but is pinned by the twins' ice.
events.quote: he took the form of Queen Ayara (who had hidden near the back of the gathering to not be seen) and shot the stag in the chest with an arrow.

events.summary: Rowan forbids Garruk to kill Oko, and Oko planeswalks away.
events.quote: planeswalking away to parts unknown

events.summary: Ashiok hires Oko for a heist of Maag Taranau, and they gather an outlaw crew.
events.quote: he was contacted by Ashiok and hired to perform a heist to steal the contents of Maag Taranau

events.summary: Oko recruits Annie Flash for her ability to see through illusions.
events.quote: attempting to recruit her for her ability to see through illusions

events.summary: Oko and the crew steal a vault key from Bertram Graywater's office.
events.quote: they secured the key

events.summary: Oko meets his son Kellan, who tracked him across planes, and takes him along as an asset.
events.quote: revealed himself to be his son Kellan , who had traveled across multiple planes looking for him

events.summary: The gang hijacks Nolan's train; zombies overrun it and Oko abandons Kellan to save the passengers alone.
events.quote: Ultimately, he left his son to save the civilians alone.

events.summary: Oko plans to infiltrate Tarnation, secretly arranging for his team to be captured and the Sterling Company raid.
events.quote: he submitted an anonymous tip about Tarnation's location to the Sterling Company so they would raid the city

events.summary: Akul combines Oko's key with his five; Kellan challenges Akul to a duel, and Oko uses the Sterling raid to steal the full key.
events.quote: Oko had Tinybones unchain him and steal the complete key, making for the vault.

events.summary: Ashiok paralyzes Kellan and Oko opens the vault, but Ashiok is revealed to be Jace in disguise; Oko planeswalks away from Vraska's gaze.
events.quote: Oko was only just able to planeswalk away before being petrified by Vraska's gaze.

events.summary: The crew disbands; Oko learns Kellan awakened his fae powers and escaped, and chooses to stay absent from his life.
events.quote: Oko accepted this outcome, as it meant he could continue to be absent from Kellan's life.

events.summary: Oko returns to Lorwyn-Shadowmoor and finds Maralen ruling Glen Elendra, plotting a trick that draws Strixhaven students there.
events.quote: he found Maralen ruling over Glen Elendra

events.summary: The students prematurely awaken Isilu, spreading Shadowmoor unnaturally.
events.quote: The students prematurely awakened Isilu

events.summary: Maralen reveals she is Oko's sister, an avatar of Oona who rebelled and destroyed her.
events.quote: She then revealed that she was his sister, another avatar of Oona who had rebelled and destroyed her.

events.summary: Oko protects Maralen and the students from elves, but Rhys wounds Maralen with a moonglow dagger.
events.quote: He was unable, however, to stop Maralen's retainer Rhys from wounding her

events.summary: Oko helps rout the elves, steals dawnglow and heals Maralen, then embraces her and reconsiders family.
events.quote: administered it to Maralen himself, which saved her from imminent death

relations.note: Oko is the first creation of Oona, designed as her avatar.
relations.quote: Oko was created on the plane of Lorwyn-Shadowmoor by the faerie queen Oona
He is the first creation of Oona and the brother of Maralen .
He is the father of the half-fae Kellan .

relations.note: They met regularly and she bore his son.
relations.quote: She eventually became pregnant with a son, the half-fae Kellan .
Oko rebelled and desired to rule in adherence to the natural cycle of the world

relations.note: He enthralled Garruk as a slave bodyguard.
relations.quote: turning him into a slave bodyguard called Dog .

relations.note: She and Jace set Oko up in the heist.
relations.quote: Jace and Vraska had set Oko up, and his usefulness was at an end.

relations.note: He posed as Ashiok to set Oko up.
relations.quote: they dispelled an illusion and revealed themself to be Jace Beleren in disguise

relations.note: They fought for the key at the vault.
relations.quote: A fight between Kellan and Oko for the key broke out
the dragon Akul , leader of the Hellspurs gang

relations.note: He is head of the Sterling Company.
He saved her life with dawnglow and embraced her.
relations.quote: they watched Oko embrace his sister and begin to tell her of his travels
